caption: The video showcases two diamond rings standing upright on a white sheet printed with rows of text, against a dark background. Their silhouettes are nearly merged, so the pair reads as a single band with one bright stone head. As the viewing angle shifts, the overlapping forms separate into two distinct rings. The right-hand ring reveals a pavé band, while the left-hand ring shows a plainer band. The cast shadow changes from a single loop into two overlapping loops and shifts its shape. Printed rows of text appear to shift and tilt across the frame. Star-shaped glints flash from the stones and metal as the angle changes. The rings remain upright and in contact with the paper throughout the excerpt. Their relative positions open from alignment into side-by-side separation, with sparkle and shadow still shifting across the scene.
relations: Shifting the viewing angle causes the merged ring silhouettes to separate into two distinct upright bands.
As the rings separate visually, the cast shadow transitions from a single loop to overlapping loops.
Changing the perspective makes the printed rows of text appear to shift and tilt across the frame.
Light interacting with the stones and metal produces star-shaped glints that flash as the angle shifts.
